_comment: Role EXTENSIONS by id (placement PR0b; PR1, bean ybwt). Each entry adds this layer's skills to a role the harness declares, so the edge points DOWN: the harness's scenarios/roles.json names no skill that lives above it. An extension adds skills and nothing else; a role this layer owns outright would go in `roles` (placement PR4 moves whole roles). Schema: cat-harness/schemas/role-graph.ts (RoleExtensionSchema); overlay: cat-harness/schemas/scenario-overlay.ts. `roles` holds the roles this layer owns outright: `l1-extraction-reviewer` (owner ruling 3b, 2026-10-12; equipped by bean 4nfs), which signs L1 extraction exclusions.
name: smart-base

roles.title: L1 extraction reviewer
roles.description: Signs, or rejects, the exclusions an L1 extraction proposes: each normative-looking sentence of a WHO publication that the curation says is not a recommendation, an implementation practice or a remark. Until a person acting in this role signs an exclusion, its sentence stays unaccounted and coverage stays below 100 %. Owner ruling 3b, 2026-10-12: exclusions are signed by this named role, never by the agent that proposed them. Inherits the harness's generic reviewer and performs exclusion sign-off in `classify-and-code-content.bpmn` (bean 4nfs).
roles.persona: Has the publication open beside the work list and reads each proposed exclusion against the printed page. A wrong exclusion silently drops guidance from every DAK built on the extraction, so they sign one only having read the sentence in place, and reject it with a reason otherwise.

roles.title: Health worker
roles.description: The generic DAK persona who delivers care at the point of care and records it on a device: completes the DAK's SDC forms and acts on its decision-support guidance (`questionnaire-data-capture.bpmn`, `act-on-decision-support.bpmn`). A DAK's own health-worker roles (a vaccinator, a community health worker) carry these skills or inherit this role. WHO's DAK personas call this a health worker; the role is a lane, never a person.
roles.persona: Overburdened and often offline, on a shared or low-end device, with a queue of clients waiting: every extra tap costs care time, so a step that is not needed for care is never required of them.
otherNames: Healthcare Provider (SMART Base generic persona DAK.Persona.HealthcareProvider)
Health worker (WHO PHC digital transformation handbook)

roles.title: Point-of-care system
roles.description: The app or EHR the health worker uses: renders the DAK's forms, extracts their resources, applies the DAK's decision tables (PlanDefinitions) and writes what the health worker accepted. Decides nothing clinical. A DAK's own systems (a CHW app, a clinic EHR) carry these skills or inherit this role.
roles.persona: Software on the health worker's device or the facility's server that works offline and synchronises later, and never writes to the record what the health worker did not accept.
otherNames: Person-centred point of service system (PCPOSS, WHO PHC digital transformation handbook)
